name: Team Bulbasaur: Earth Shatter & Levitate Control
archetype: Levitate Ground immunity, 4x Grass STAB, and Intimidate Water pivots.
gym_duel_rationale: Giovanni commands heavy Ground, Rock, and Fighting juggernauts. When challenged, select your 5 designated Pokémon: Venusaur/Charizard (4x Grass STAB crushes Rhyperior/Lapras while resisting Ground and Fighting), Gyarados/Arbok (Intimidate blunts Golem/Machamp and Primeape/Nidoking while Aqua Tail sweeps), Alakazam/Weezing (Levitate grants complete immunity to Giovanni's Earthquakes while STAB Psychic demolishes his Fighting types), Kingler/Primeape (monstrous Crabhammer and Close Combat to shatter Rhydon/Snorlax), and Snorlax (colossal HP sponge that tanks hits and stalls out Sandstorm turns).

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST Grass/Fire powerhouse. Resists Fighting and Grass attacks while firing devastating Grass and Fire STABs. Completely counters Rhyperior/Lapras with 4x super-effective Petal Dance.
513 BST Intimidate bruiser. Intimidate neutralizes Giovanni's heavy physical attackers upon switch-in. STAB Aqua Tail washes away Golem/Machamp and Electabuzz/Dugtrio.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Levitate makes it 100% immune to Giovanni's Earthquakes, allowing free Calm Mind setups and STAB Psychic sweeps against Primeape/Nidoking.
500 BST high-Attack physical breaker. Crabhammer shreds Ground and Rock types, while STAB Close Combat delivers massive super-effective damage to Giovanni's Rhydon/Snorlax ace.
Colossal 160 HP normal wall. Absorbs special and physical punishment with ease. Body Slam provides consistent STAB damage and paralysis chance while Rest + Sleep Talk keeps it healthy.
High-Speed Flying scout. Immune to Ground-type Earthquake. Provides Tailwind speed control for the team and roosts off damage reliably.

flex_bench.role: Compound Eyes Quiver Dance Sleep Pivot
flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder and Quiver Dance setup against slow encounter tables.
High-speed Electric coverage packing Discharge and Light Screen.
High-Attack High Jump Kick wallbreaker with Unburden speed doubling.
